articles.summary: Actions align leadership and capabilities across Distribution Marketing, PC Claims, and Life Kemper Corporation (NYSE: KMPR) today announced the formation of an enterprise Distribution Marketing organization and leadership appointments in its PC and Life businesses. Together, these actions support Kemper’s strategic priorities by aligning leadership and capabilities in areas central to performance and long-term profitable growth. The new Distribution Marketing organization will bring together sales and marketing resources across Kemper’s businesses under the leadership of Chris Flint, who has been named Chief Distribution Marketing Officer, reporting to President and Chief Executive Officer Steve McAnena. Flint most recently served as President of Kemper Life, a position he held since 2023. The organization will strengthen and coordinate Kemper’s distribution capabilities while supporting each business’s distinct strategy and profitable growth
articles.title: Kemper Establishes Enterprise Distribution & Marketing Organization and Announces Business Leadership Appointments
